summary: Carlyle Private Equity Partners Fund filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of equity securities under Item 3.02, disclosing the sale of 454,557 limited partnership units across multiple classes for aggregate consideration of approximately $13.2 million on April 1, 2026, priced at March 31, 2026 Transactional NAV per unit. The sale was part of the Fund's continuous private offering exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, including units purchased by an affiliate of the general partner. The filing also restated the Fund's valuation policy under Item 8.01. This is a routine capital raise by an investment fund, not a special situation.
